standard.summary: 为 CPU 侧 offload 缓冲启用页锁定内存，默认关闭。
standard.effect: 让 CPU 缓冲使用 pinned memory，供异步 H2D 传输使用。
standard.whenToUse: CPU 内存充足且需要优化 offload 传输时再开启。
standard.avoidWhen: 系统内存紧张或 pinned memory 造成资源压力时保持关闭。

standard_en.summary: Use pinned memory for CPU-side offload buffers. Disabled by default.
standard_en.effect: Allows asynchronous host-to-device transfers from CPU buffers.
standard_en.whenToUse: Enable it when system memory is sufficient and offload transfer speed matters.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Keep it off when system memory is tight or pinned memory adds pressure.
